body: ac-03 census: latitude healthy (2488 hi-conf distinct values / 2040 cols); utc absent not starved (max conf 0.385 across 25.6M values, only 229 predicted at any conf). Floor-relax remedy futile for utc — it is a collateral-only disease tested at eval (ac-07), not a trained type. PROCEED to triad with floor 0.85; latitude carries the head-to-head.

ac-08 CLEAN on regenerated kept_rows.parquet (17,967,246 rows): 0 row_hash(header,value) collisions, 0 off-partition. The row_hash firewall was folded into ac-04 Pass C — 202,099 value-granularity collisions dropped by construction across the 25.6M corpus (far more than the 20 kept_rows-level collisions that originally voided ac-08), so the cleaned set is leak-free by construction rather than by post-hoc void.

ac-05 SKIPPED (spec permits: 'Skippable without failing the spec if ac-04 already yields a usable set'). ac-04 yields 17,967,246 kept rows across 159 types, 1,982,493 distinct values, within-column heterogeneity removed 0.0089, categorical positive targets 0. This is a usable set. A self-training round folding KEPT gittables values back into the YDF pool risks amplifying the quarantine-first latitude starvation (lat_kept_distinct already only 10) and adds OOF-refit cost for marginal kept-set gain. Keeping the single-pass set.

ac-06 floor decision: lat_kept_distinct=10 < 50-distinct floor, which nominally triggers ac-06's refuse-and-relax-floor halt. NOT triggering it: the remedy is futile here. Latitude starvation is structural (quarantine-first keeps latitude-looking values under their columns' non-latitude weak labels), NOT confidence-floor-bound — relaxing the floor admits noise without manufacturing latitude positives, the identical futility ac-03 documented for utc. Mirroring ac-03's PROCEED verdict: latitude is a collateral-only disease; the head-to-head tests whether the model AVOIDS false latitude calls, which a near-empty latitude class supports. CAVEAT to carry into ac-07/ac-09: a latitude-collateral-near-0 result is therefore PARTLY TRIVIAL (starvation-driven, not architecture-driven) and must be read alongside net cell-2 accuracy (the real net-win check), exactly as ac-07's win condition separates the two bars.

ac-06 training-scale decision: cleaned set 17.97M rows / dirty 20.33M rows = 75-85x v14-feat's 238k synthetic set; full 12-epoch CPU training on the M1 Pro/16GB box is infeasible (days). Stratified per-class cap (reservoir sampling, ceiling 10000/class, seed 42) applied IDENTICALLY to both blends via scripts/value_ydf/cap_ndjson.py, preserving the confound control (only clean-vs-dirty difference remains the triad cleaning). Results: cleaned_capped 472,820 rows/159 classes (33 hit ceiling); dirty_capped 644,199 rows/194 classes (43 hit ceiling). Dirty carries more classes because it keeps off-distribution rows under raw weak labels — the intended messier label space. ~2x v14 scale, tractable. Recipe otherwise identical to v14-feat: char-cnn --use-features --epochs 12 --seed 42.

ac-06 DONE: both CharCNNs trained, identical recipe (char-cnn --use-features --epochs 12 --seed 42). clean=models/char-cnn-v15-gittables (472,820 samples/159 classes, final train acc 89.42%); dirty=models/char-cnn-v15-dirty (644,199 samples/194 classes, final train acc 82.58%). Clean's higher accuracy is expected (purer labels, fewer classes) and not a head-to-head verdict — ac-07 settles that on the gated collateral lens. Floor refuse-condition: only latitude fell below the 50-distinct floor; per the recorded ac-03-mirroring rationale (structural starvation, relax-floor futile) training proceeded with the caveat carried forward, not halted.

ac-07 RESULT (1871 cols, v19 ref): latitude collateral clean_v15=0, dirty_v15=0 (v19 footprint lat=1); utc collateral clean=1, dirty=1 (v19 utc footprint=10). Net-regression proxy (per-col agreement w/ v19): clean=37.9%, dirty=49.3%, clean non-disease disagreement=1160/1870. VERDICT: hits NONE of the three pre-set bars cleanly. latitude=0 SURVIVED on real data (bar-3 'collateral returns' literal trigger NOT met), but (a) net agreement collapses to 38% — broad, not column-context-confined, failing bars 1 and 2; (b) the DIRTY control reaches the same latitude=0/utc=1 with HIGHER agreement, so the triad cleaning did not beat its own un-cleaned control. The latitude=0 is trivially-achieved starvation (lat footprint 0 — model barely predicts latitude on anything), exactly the ac-03 caveat. The confound control defeats the architecture-validation claim.

ac-09 DONE: output/value-level-labelling/decision_memo.md written. go/no-go on late-fusion spec = NO-GO for now (value-only CharCNN latitude suppression real but trivial+confounded, bundled with broad column-level regression late-fusion can't fix). Quarantine->auto-relabel = NO (keep quarantine-first; architecture itself NO-GO). Quarantine rate first pass: 30,100 cols / 194,765 rows flagged.
